CommunityApplications.Profile:
A Docker dashboard for a PrusaLink printer, designed for UNRAID, phones, a desktop corner or a room display. No printer credentials are sent to the browser.
- Large color-coded printer state, remaining time and estimated finish. - Separate filament-change countdown, connection health and last successful update. - Desktop, compact, mobile and across-the-room layouts selectable in the web UI. - State-change sounds with mute, acknowledge and full-screen controls. - Optional RTSP/HTTP camera converted to browser-viewable MJPEG by FFmpeg.
